_comment: Factory metrics rendered on the site. Owned by scripts/update-metrics.mjs — edit through that, not by hand. `rendered` is the literal text currently present in the HTML; the updater uses it to find and replace, then rewrites it. If you hand-edit a number in a page, update `rendered` in the same commit or the next run will not find it.
method: GitHub search API, org:Bygmedai, default branches only, private repositories included. Commits and pull requests counted from 2026-02-01; a search for commits before that date returns zero, which is what fixes February as the factory's start.

notes.copyrightYear: Appears in the footer of 49 pages. Not a metric, but the same problem: a value quoted everywhere that becomes wrong on a fixed date. The rendered string deliberately includes the name — the bare year appears 278 times across the site in article dates, JSON-LD and body copy, and replacing that would rewrite history rather than a footer.
notes.inkandartPullRequests: Same two repositories. Replaces a hedged '200+' with the counted figure — the page beside it says 'counted, not rounded'.
notes.neverSeparate: A year is not a quantity. Without this, 2026 rendered as '2,026' in 46 footers.
notes.rendered: Every entry must be unique enough to identify exactly one claim. A bare number is not: replacing '48' rewrote 196 unrelated numbers across 25 files — dates, colour values — before expectedHits existed to stop it.
notes.repositories: Counted with archived:false. The site says 'in active development', and 27 of the organisation's 48 repositories are archived — so 48 was the wrong number for that sentence. Changing 30+ to 48 made the claim less true, not more.
notes.solutions: 15 as of 18 August 2026, confirmed by Steven, who also archived one. Still never auto-updated: what counts as a client-facing delivery is a judgement, not a query.
notes.yearsExperience: Steven started in 2006, so this is the current year minus careerStart — never a typed number. The site said "18 years" in 19 places and "18+ years" in 17 more, while the Danish page said "20+ års erfaring" and book-session said "20+ years of experience": four figures for one fact, three of them wrong. A hardcoded 20 would have been wrong again on 1 January.
notes.careerStart: The year the career started. The only thing anyone should ever edit about years of experience.
notes.expectedHits: Counted against the site, not guessed. Two entries were wrong before the no-op path started verifying them: pullRequests claimed 6 where the site had 5, and copyrightYear claimed 46 after eight tool pages gained a footer and made it 54. Neither was visible until a value changed, which for a year is 1 January.
